response.sql:
WITH observatory_shares AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         COUNT(*) AS telescope_count,
         100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_pct
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
shares_with_average AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(share_pct) OVER () AS average_share_pct
  FROM observatory_shares
)
SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescope_count,
       AVG(share_pct) AS average_share_pct,
       AVG(share_pct - average_share_pct) AS average_excess_share_pct
FROM shares_with_average
WHERE share_pct > average_share_pct;

assumptions.assumption: All observatories in scope are those represented by at least one row in telescopes; observatories with zero telescopes are excluded because they have no row in the telescopes table.
